Confidence Explained

Confidence bands are relative, not absolute probabilities. They reflect how aligned the route is with your current constraints, mastery state, and pace.

very highAll constraints favorable. Low workload variance. Consistent history.
highMinor gaps exist but route is well-matched to capacity.
mediumSome prerequisite gaps or moderate overload risk.
lowSignificant mismatch between route demands and current state.
very lowRoute is likely infeasible without major constraint changes.
